name: @projexlight/connector-zoom
summary: Zoom connector: OAuth install + meeting scheduling + recording ingest. Lets a ProjexCloud encounter (sales demo, support call, customer onboarding) create + reconcile against a real Zoom meeting + pull the recording into sdk-media + sdk-evidence for archive.

events.name: connector-zoom.meeting.scheduled.v1
events.description: Meeting created in Zoom against a ProjexCloud encounter.

events.name: connector-zoom.meeting.ended.v1
events.description: Meeting ended; carries duration + participant count.

events.name: connector-zoom.recording.ingested.v1
events.description: Recording pulled into sdk-media; carries blob_id + sha256.

models.description: Per-meeting row: zoom_meeting_id, host_user_id, encounter_id, status.

hooks.name: scheduleMeeting
hooks.description: Create a Zoom meeting against a ProjexCloud encounter; returns join_url.

hooks.name: ingestRecording
hooks.description: Pull a finished recording into sdk-media + link to the meeting row.

hooks.name: startRecordingPoller
hooks.description: Background worker: catches recordings that webhook didn't deliver.

scenarios.title: Tenant connects Zoom account
scenarios.when_to_use: Admin grants OAuth scopes for meeting + recording access.
scenarios.example_code:
import { installConnector } from '@projexlight/connector-zoom';
const { install_id } = await installConnector({ tenant_id, auth_code });

scenarios.title: Sales encounter creates a Zoom meeting
scenarios.when_to_use: Sales rep books a demo; ProjexCloud calls scheduleMeeting to create the matching Zoom meeting + sends the join_url via sdk-notification.

scenarios.title: Recording completed → pulled into sdk-media + sdk-evidence
scenarios.when_to_use: Webhook fires recording.completed; we pull the recording bytes into sdk-media, then sdk-evidence registers a capture for archive.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Recording stored in sdk-media (presigned upload); evidence capture written; emits .recording.ingested.v1 with blob_id.

scenarios.title: Webhook updates meeting duration + participant count
scenarios.when_to_use: Zoom fires meeting.ended; we update the row + project duration into sdk-projection for billing / utilization analytics.
scenarios.example_code:
import { handleWebhook } from '@projexlight/connector-zoom';
await handleWebhook({ tenant_id, signature, body, event_type: 'meeting.ended' });

scenarios.title: Poller backstops missed webhook events
scenarios.when_to_use: Zoom occasionally drops webhooks; the poller scans recent meetings every 15 min to catch any recording the webhook missed.
scenarios.example_code:
import { startRecordingPoller } from '@projexlight/connector-zoom';
startRecordingPoller({ tenant_id, interval_min: 15 });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Missing recordings caught + ingested; emits .recording.ingested.v1 with reason='poller-backstop'.

compliance_posture.notes: Refresh tokens vault-wrapped; webhook verify-token mandatory. HIPAA tenants pin to Zoom for Healthcare; recordings ingested under retention_class='regulated' so retention shredder honors policy.
